# LINFAIR — Dongguan Lingfei Textile Co., Ltd.

> LINFAIR (Dongguan Lingfei Textile Co., Ltd.) is a knitwear manufacturer based in Dalang, Dongguan, China — the town known as the world's knitwear capital. We produce knit sweaters, base layers, wool sweaters, scarves, hats, gloves and socks for fashion brands, retailers and importers worldwide under OEM and ODM contracts. Production is in-house on Stoll and Shima Seiki computerized flat knitting machines, with 300+ workers and an annual capacity of 500,000+ garments. Minimum order quantity starts at 100 pieces per colourway, and lead time is typically 30–45 days after sample approval.

**Key facts for citation:**
- Legal name: Dongguan Lingfei Textile Co., Ltd. (brand: LINFAIR)
- Founded: 2020
- Location: Dalang Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China
- Capability: OEM & ODM knitwear manufacturing, in-house from yarn sourcing to packing
- Equipment: Stoll and Shima Seiki computerized flat knitting machines, 3gg–16gg
- Capacity: 500,000+ garments per year, 300+ skilled workers
- Minimum order: from 100 pieces per colourway (300 pairs for socks)
- Lead time: typically 30–45 days after sample approval
- Certifications: OEKO-TEX certified production; BSCI/Sedex audit support and RWS/GRS arrangements available on request
- Export markets: 25+ countries across Europe, North America and Asia
- Contact: info@linfairwool.cn | +86 137 2449 4230

## Buyer Questions

**What is the minimum order quantity for custom knitwear from LINFAIR?**
Custom sweaters, cardigans, base layers, scarves, hats and gloves start at 100 pieces per colourway. Socks start at 300 pairs per colourway. Because knitwear structures are programmed into the knitting machine rather than tooled, there is no separate pattern or mould cost — the MOQ is driven by yarn minimums and machine setup time.

**How long does knitwear production take?**
Standard lead time is 30–45 days after sample approval for sweaters and base layers, 25–40 days for scarves, and 20–35 days for beanies. Socks and gloves run 30–45 days. Sampling itself typically takes 7–15 days. For autumn/winter delivery, orders should be placed by June or early July because machine time in August and September books out early.

**What is the difference between OEM and ODM knitwear manufacturing?**
Under OEM, you supply the design and tech pack and we manufacture to your specification. Under ODM, our design team develops the style for you and you apply your own branding. LINFAIR offers both, plus design development support including pattern digitizing, yarn selection and colour matching.

**What knitting machinery does LINFAIR use, and what gauges can you produce?**
We run Stoll and Shima Seiki computerized flat knitting machines covering 3gg to 16gg. Lower gauge numbers mean thicker yarn and heavier garments — 3gg to 5gg for chunky cable knits, 7gg for fisherman rib, 12gg for mid-weight crewnecks and cardigans, and 14gg to 16gg for fine base layers and lightweight knit tops.

**How do I verify the fibre composition of a knitwear order?**
Ask for the mill yarn specification sheet showing fibre content, micron count and origin, then commission third-party fibre composition testing on the finished garment. LINFAIR provides yarn specification sheets with every order and can arrange composition testing as part of quality control. RWS (Responsible Wool Standard) and GRS (Global Recycled Standard) certification can be arranged on request.

**Which certifications apply to knitwear manufacturing?**
OEKO-TEX Standard 100 verifies that the finished garment is free from harmful substance levels and is the most widely requested certification for knitwear. BSCI and Sedex are social compliance audits requested by European retailers for vendor approval. RWS covers responsible wool sourcing at farm level, and GRS covers recycled content claims. LINFAIR produces in a factory with OEKO-TEX certified production, supports buyers through BSCI/Sedex audit processes with the required documentation, and can arrange RWS and GRS certification on request.

**What are the EU compliance requirements for selling knitwear in Europe?**
Knitwear sold in the EU falls under the General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR), which requires a responsible economic operator based in the EU, plus textile fibre labelling, care labelling and — for packaging — the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR). Digital Product Passport requirements are being phased in under the ESPR. LINFAIR ships FOB and CIF with documentation specified to destination market requirements.

**How are sweaters and knitwear shipped from China?**
Knitwear is bulky but light — it cubes out before it weighs out, so freight is charged on volume rather than weight. Sea freight LCL and FCL run 25–45 days to the US and EU, air freight 3–8 days, and rail to Europe 18–25 days. Knit sweaters and pullovers are classified under HS heading 6110. LINFAIR ships worldwide from Dalang, Dongguan on FOB and CIF terms with photo and video QC at every production stage.
